integrity: The theorem uses exact Poisson splitting, a convergent marked excursion characteristic transform and exact partial fractions. Reproducible numerical and rational checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive exponential holding rate and positive reset probability, deterministic positive original velocity; no extension to Erlang-2 or theta=0, no independent validation and no claim of historically certified priority. The 2026 source already establishes stationarity and stationary first moment; only the elementary stationary law, integral evaluation and sign contrast are assessed.
title: Closed stationary telegraph law and the mean-majority polarity reversal
